improvements.areaName: SEO Meta Description and OG Tags
improvements.suggestion:
<meta name="description" content="Gideon is your Claude-powered AI assistant for trade and business. Get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support. Try three free searches, then join from US$2/day.">
<meta property="og:title" content="GDN AI – Gideon | Your AI Trade & Business Assistant">
<meta property="og:description" content="Claude-powered AI assistant for business owners, traders, and professionals. Instant answers, voice chat, unlimited workspace. Start with 3 free searches.">
<meta property="og:type" content="website">
<meta property="og:image" content="https://gdn.ai/og-image.jpg">
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">
<meta name="twitter:title" content="GDN AI – Gideon | AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant">
<meta name="twitter:description" content="Professional AI support for trade and business. Try Gideon free, then unlock unlimited access from US$2/day.">
improvements.rationale: A compelling meta description improves click-through rates from search results by clearly communicating the product value and free trial offer. Open Graph tags ensure professional, branded previews when the homepage is shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, or Facebook—critical for a B2B audience. Including the price anchor and free searches reduces friction and sets expectations before the click.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support for your business operations. Try three free searches today — no credit card required."
improvements.rationale: This headline immediately introduces the product name and core function, building brand recognition. The subheading highlights three key value props (instant answers, voice chat, professional support) while clearly communicating the risk-free trial offer. The 'no credit card required' implication removes friction and encourages immediate engagement with the free searches.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches with Gideon, you'll be invited to choose a membership plan to continue. Plans start from just US$2 per day, and you can select monthly or annual billing—annual members save 30 percent. Your membership unlocks unlimited access to Gideon's AI-powered trade and business support, voice chat, and your own members workspace.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the conversion moment when free users hit the paywall. By clearly explaining what happens next and reinforcing the low entry price and annual savings, it reduces friction and uncertainty, helping convert trial users into paying members.
